body: On the required 100-project/10k-card/50k-report release dataset, ordinary Attention p50/p95/p99 improves from 83.6/85.9/90.1 to 31.9/32.7/34.2 ms (200 samples after warmup). The same predicates, scopes, ordering, receipts, cursor rules and durable-write behavior remain. Actual Focus Attention with 50k unread reports still has p95 85.5 ms; no equivalent full-UI speedup is claimed. A statement-local archival exclusion prototype worsens that path to 120.2 ms p95 and is reverted. The full and combined gates pass 255 Rust, 137 JavaScript and 12 Python tests; four affected Chromium/WebKit suites, broad HTTPS and latest counter/card/Focus checks pass. The original manual app is rebuilt/restarted: all 45 prior resource versions, pins, preferences and certificate are preserved, with trusted HTTPS and all 33 assets verified. Temporary benchmark code is removed. Physical-device, transport and full release acceptance remain open. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-attention-filters.md.

metadata.summary: Verified Attention eligibility filtering cuts ordinary query latency by about 62%.
